title: Girls' Cotton Sleeveless Summer Dress with Flared Skirt
description:
A cheerful sleeveless dress in soft cotton with a twirly flared skirt, made for warm days, parties and holidays. Ages 2–9.
• Material: 100% cotton poplin with a lined bodice
• Round neckline with button fastening at the back
• Gathered waist and knee-length flared skirt
• Colours: yellow and pink
• Machine wash at 30°C

title: Girls' Unicorn Print Long Sleeve Jersey Dress
description:
A comfy long sleeve jersey dress with a playful unicorn print, easy to pull on for school, play and weekends. Ages 2–9.
• Material: 95% cotton, 5% elastane jersey
• Round neckline and long sleeves
• Skater-style skirt that ends just above the knee
• Colour: blue
• Machine wash at 40°C inside out

title: Girls' Layered Tulle Tutu Skirt with Elastic Waist
description:
A soft, puffy tutu skirt with several layers of tulle over a satin lining, great for dressing up, dance class and birthday parties. Ages 2–10.
• Material: 100% polyester tulle with a polyester satin lining
• Four tulle layers for extra volume
• Wide, soft elasticated waistband
• Length approx. 30–38 cm depending on size
• Hand wash cold

title: Girls' Cotton T-Shirt and Shorts Set
description:
An easy summer outfit: a soft cotton tee paired with shorts that have a comfy elasticated waist. Ages 4–13.
• Material: 100% cotton jersey
• Short sleeve T-shirt with a round neck
• Shorts with an elasticated waist and side pockets
• Set includes T-shirt and shorts
• Machine wash at 40°C

title: Boys' Striped Cotton T-Shirt, Pack of 2
description:
Two classic striped tees in soft cotton jersey that go with shorts, jeans and joggers. Ages 2–13.
• Material: 100% cotton jersey, 160 g/m²
• Crew neck with a soft rib trim
• Regular fit with short sleeves
• Pack of 2: grey stripe and navy stripe
• Machine wash at 40°C

title: Boys' Long Sleeve Check Shirt in Cotton
description:
A smart check shirt in soft cotton for school events, family occasions and everyday wear. Ages 4–11.
• Material: 100% cotton
• Button-down collar and full button front
• Long sleeves with button cuffs, plus a chest pocket
• Colours: blue check and red check
• Machine wash at 40°C

title: Boys' Fleece Pullover Hoodie
description:
A warm, cosy pullover hoodie with a brushed fleece inside and a front pocket for small treasures. Ages 4–11.
• Material: 70% cotton, 30% polyester fleece
• Lined hood with no cords
• Front kangaroo pocket; ribbed cuffs and hem
• Colours: white and grey
• Machine wash at 30°C

title: Boys' Stretch Chino Trousers with Adjustable Waist
description:
Smart stretch chinos with an adjustable inner waistband, so they keep fitting as your child grows. Ages 4–13.
• Material: 97% cotton, 3% elastane twill
• Adjustable button-elastic inner waistband, zip fly and button
• Two front pockets and two back pockets
• Colour: brown
• Machine wash at 30°C

title: Kids' Hooded Puffer Coat with Fleece-Lined Hood
description:
A warm, padded winter coat with a cosy fleece-lined hood that keeps little ones snug on cold days. Ages 2–9.
• Shell: 100% polyester with water-repellent finish; padding: polyester fibre fill
• Fixed hood with no cords; front zip with chin guard
• Two zip pockets and elasticated cuffs
• Reflective strip on the back
• Machine wash at 30°C

title: Kids' Water-Resistant Hooded Raincoat
description:
A bright, lightweight raincoat that keeps children dry on rainy walks to school and puddle-jumping days. Ages 2–9.
• Material: 100% polyester with PU coating and taped seams; mesh lining
• Fixed hood with no cords
• Press-stud front fastening and two flap pockets
• Reflective details on the front and back
• Colour: yellow

title: Kids' Full-Zip Fleece Jacket
description:
A soft, lightweight fleece jacket for layering under a coat in winter or wearing on its own on cool spring days. Ages 4–11.
• Material: 100% polyester micro-fleece
• Full-length zip with chin guard and stand collar
• Two zip side pockets
• Elasticated cuffs and hem
• Colours: grey and navy

title: Kids' Cotton Long Sleeve Pajama Set
description:
Soft, comfy cotton pajamas with a long sleeve top and full-length bottoms for a cosy night's sleep. Ages 2–11.
• Material: 100% cotton jersey
• Round neck top with long sleeves and ribbed cuffs
• Bottoms with a soft elasticated waist
• Set includes top and bottoms
• Machine wash at 40°C

title: Kids' Pink Cotton Jersey Pajama Set
description:
A sweet pink pajama set in stretchy cotton jersey with a snug fit for comfortable sleep. Ages 1–6.
• Material: 95% cotton, 5% elastane jersey
• Long sleeve top with a round neck
• Snug-fit bottoms with an elasticated waist and ankle cuffs
• Set includes top and bottoms
• Machine wash at 40°C

title: Toddler Zip-Up Footed Sleepsuit, Pack of 2
description:
Easy-on zip sleepsuits with covered feet, ideal for toddlers who kick off their blankets. Ages 6 months to 3 years.
• Material: 100% cotton interlock
• Two-way zip with a fabric guard at the chin
• Enclosed feet with non-slip dots on the soles
• Pack of 2 in assorted colours
• Machine wash at 40°C

title: Kids' Two-Piece Tracksuit, Zip Jacket and Joggers
description:
A matching tracksuit for sports, play and travel, with a zip-up jacket and comfortable joggers. Ages 4–11.
• Material: 100% polyester tricot
• Jacket: stand collar, full zip and two side pockets
• Joggers: elasticated waist and cuffed ankles
• Set includes jacket and joggers
• Colours: blue-green and black

title: Kids' Fleece Sweatshirt and Jogger Set
description:
A cosy two-piece set with a crew neck sweatshirt and matching joggers, soft enough for lounging and tough enough for the playground. Ages 4–13.
• Material: 65% cotton, 35% polyester brushed fleece
• Crew neck sweatshirt with ribbed cuffs and hem
• Joggers with an elasticated waist and cuffs
• Set includes sweatshirt and joggers
• Colour: black

title: Kids' Colour-Block Pullover Sports Hoodie
description:
A lightweight colour-block hoodie in quick-drying fabric for PE, football practice and active days. Ages 4–13.
• Material: 100% polyester with a soft brushed back
• Lined hood with no cords
• Front kangaroo pocket and thumbholes in the cuffs
• Colours: black and red
• Machine wash at 30°C

title: Kids' Knitted Beanie with Fleece Lining
description:
A soft, stretchy knitted beanie with a warm fleece lining to keep ears cosy on cold days. Ages 2–10.
• Material: 100% acrylic knit with a polyester fleece lining
• Ribbed knit with a fold-over cuff
• Stretchy fit for head circumference approx. 48–54 cm
• Colours: pink, navy and grey
• Hand wash cold

title: Kids' Woven Straw Sun Hat with Wide Brim
description:
A lightweight woven sun hat with a wide brim that shades the face and neck at the beach, in the garden or on holiday. Ages 2–8.
• Material: paper straw with a cotton sweatband
• Wide brim, approx. 8 cm
• Adjustable inner band and a breakaway chin strap
• Fits head circumference approx. 48–54 cm
• Spot clean only

title: Kids' Small Backpack with Padded Straps
description:
A lightweight backpack sized for little shoulders, with room for a lunch box, water bottle and a change of clothes. Ages 3+.
• Material: 600D polyester with water-repellent coating; lined interior
• Main zip compartment and a front zip pocket
• Padded adjustable straps and a chest strap
• Size approx. 30 x 23 x 11 cm, about 7 litres
• Colours: navy, pink and green
